content: Hi, do you have any Salwar Suits under 4000?

Hello! Yes, we have the Anarkali Salwar Suit (SKU-SUIT-001) in Yellow, crafted in Cotton Blend for INR 3,499. We also have Chanderi Silk Suit Set (SKU-SUIT-002) for INR 4,200. Would you like to check out the Anarkali Suit for INR 3,499?
Yes, what sizes are available in that yellow one?
The Anarkali Salwar Suit (SKU-SUIT-001) is available in M, L, and XL sizes. We have 12 items left in stock. Would you like to order size M?
I will think about it and let you know. Thanks!
You are most welcome! Feel free to message back anytime. Have a lovely day!
